summary.en: A detail card builds itself field by field as a fill cursor jumps ahead from slot to slot; one value is struck and replaced on the way.
summary.zh: 一张详情卡像被逐字段自动填好：填充光标领先一格跳到下一个槽位，骨架让位给内容；途中一个数值被划掉、换成新值。

fits: Showing structured extraction or autofill, or walking the viewer through what one item carries (picture, name, tags, a changed value, key lines, variants, an action).
notFor: A list of many items (one card only); a real product page shown as a screenshot; a cut that must land on one big moment (the card is a run of small events).

overlaps.note: corners bite onto one target; field-fill cursor hops through every slot of a card and morphs between them
rows of a list arrive into a page; field-fill fills the fields of one card

intent.en: Turn 'a card appears' into 'a form is being filled': the eye is led through what one item carries in order, and the one value struck and replaced is the scene's single change of meaning.
intent.zh: 把“出现一张卡”变成“一张表正在被填写”：视线被领着按顺序走一遍一个条目的信息结构，途中被划掉换新的那个数值，是整屏唯一的语义变化。

content.en: One item: an optional picture, an eyebrow (en ≤ 28 chars, zh ≤ 12), a one-word name (en ≤ 10, zh ≤ 5), 2–3 tags, an old and a new value (≤ 6 chars) with a chip, 2–3 key lines (en ≤ 38, zh ≤ 18), a swatch label and a call to action.
content.zh: 一个条目：可选一张图、一行眉标（英文 ≤ 28 字符，中文 ≤ 12 字）、一个词的名称（英文 ≤ 10，中文 ≤ 5）、2–3 个标签、一旧一新两个数值（≤ 6 字符）加一枚小标、2–3 行要点（英文 ≤ 38，中文 ≤ 18）、色卡说明和一个按钮文字。

fits.zh: 表现结构化抽取或自动填写，或带观众过一遍一个条目带着哪些信息（图、名称、标签、一个改变的数值、要点、变体、操作）。

notFor.zh: 很多项的列表（只放一张卡）；当作截图展示的真实产品页；需要落在一个大时刻上的镜头（这张卡是一串小事件）。

pairs.note: show the finished item as the one in focus

en: Keep the ~1.3 s slow push after the last field; it is the time to read the whole card, not dead air.
Key lines do not wrap; longer copy or Chinese must be refitted to size and line length or it overflows the card.
When the real item has more or fewer fields, re-space the timetable by field group; keep the struck value in the middle.
zh: 最后一个字段落定后约 1.3 秒的缓推是给观众通读整卡的，别当空白砍掉。
要点行不换行；更长的文案或中文要重配字号与行长，否则溢出卡边。
真实条目字段数变了，要按字段分组重排时间表；划价换新那一下留在中段。

upstream.name: 字段逐个落位
upstream.summary: 详情卡像被逐字段抓取般自建——一枚"填充光标"领先跳格，图→标题→分类 pill 依次 pop→原价出现后被划线降级、强调色新价 spring 跳出→正文逐行揭示且高亮块由左向右刷过→色卡点亮→按钮填满，整卡全程极慢 scale 前推
upstream.use: 商品/条目详情页的能力展示；"结构化抽取""自动填充""数据自己长出来"类叙事的主镜头
upstream.energy: 中（连续小事件密集排布，无单点爆发；靠前推保持推进感）
